issue: Coupons are applied once per cart line instead of once per cart: a $5 coupon on a cart with two lines takes $10 off. A coupon must be applied exactly once to the cart total, and the total can never go below 0.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

Coupons are applied once per cart line instead of once per cart: a $5 coupon on a cart with two lines takes $10 off. A coupon must be applied exactly once to the cart total, and the total can never go below 0.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q` (the full suite takes about 30 seconds). When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
